consequence.statement: If --registry is still passed, Crossplane core returns an error saying the flag is no longer supported, since default registry support was removed; packages and their dependencies must have fully qualified names stating their registry.
consequence.remediation: Remove the --registry flag and use fully qualified package names (including dependencies).

assertion.statement: The --registry flag of the Crossplane core is no longer supported in v2.0.0; startup returns an error telling users to use fully qualified package names.
